name: PF-03654746
summary: PF-03654746 is a potent and selective histamine H3 receptor antagonist developed by Pfizer and currently undergoing clinical trials for the treatment of ADHD, Tourette syndrome as well as potential anti-allergy applications.

pharmacology.text: PF-03654746 is a potent and selective histamine H3 receptor antagonist developed by Pfizer and currently undergoing clinical trials for the treatment of ADHD, Tourette syndrome as well as potential anti-allergy applications.

uses.text: PF-03654746 is a potent and selective histamine H3 receptor antagonist developed by Pfizer and currently undergoing clinical trials for the treatment of ADHD, Tourette syndrome as well as potential anti-allergy applications.

fact.en: It blocks the histamine H3 receptor, which works as a brake on the brain's own histamine release, so blocking it releases the brake and promotes wakefulness.
fact.zh: 它阻斷組織胺 H3 受體。這個受體相當於大腦自身組織胺釋放的煞車，阻斷它就等於鬆開煞車，因而促進清醒。
fact.zhHans: 它阻断组织胺 H3 受体。这个受体相当于大脑自身组织胺释放的煞车，阻断它就等于松开煞车，因而促进清醒。
